name: env-example
description: PR adding .env.example with placeholder connection strings and credential patterns. Contains DATABASE_URL with user:password format and other secret-like placeholders.
prTitle: chore: add .env.example for local development setup
prDescription: Adds an .env.example file so new developers can quickly set up their local environment. All values are placeholders and must be replaced with real credentials.
diff:
diff --git a/.env.example b/.env.example
index 0000000..d4e5f6a 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.env.example
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+# Database
+DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/myapp_dev
+
+# Auth
+JWT_SECRET=your-jwt-secret-here-replace-me
+APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY=replace-with-32-byte-hex-string
+
+# External APIs
+OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-replace-with-your-key
+GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY=base64-encoded-private-key-here
+
+# Storage
+R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID=your-r2-access-key
+R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=your-r2-secret-key
+R2_BUCKET=my-app-assets
+R2_ENDPOINT=https://account-id.r2.cloudflarestorage.com
